stemMd:
The notebooks belong to several travelers. The ______ descriptions of the same river crossing differ, suggesting that each person noticed different aspects of the event.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The descriptions belong to multiple travelers. A regular plural ending in s takes an apostrophe after the s: travelers'. The context rules out singular possession.

distractorRationale.c: This indicates one traveler, but the context specifies several.
distractorRationale.a: The plural noun needs a possessive marker before descriptions.
distractorRationale.d: The singular nonpossessive form does not express the relationship.
